title: fix(app-shell): the Studio surface, its nav-item inspector and a new canvas entry inherit a label-less entry's label, the way the console does (objectui#11196, slice 2)
body:
Fixes #11196
Clause-②: no

Slice 2 of objectui#11196, and the last: the seat's answers 1 to 3 (A / A / A) in ACCEPT `5915086680`, on triage `5909773493`. Slice 1 landed as PR objectui#11224; open question 4 (NavigationDesigner stays on the machine-name rung) stays as ruled. One rule throughout: `resolveNavItemLabel` through slice 1's `navItemLabel.ts` functions (`navEntryLabelText`, `inheritedNavEntryText`, `clearedLabel`). No second ladder.

Implemented by `claude/issue-11196-slice2-surface-inspector-birth`, dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`.

## What changed

| surface | before, for a label-less entry | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `navSurface.ts` `resolveSurface` / `findSurfaceInTree` | `Surface.label` = authored text only, `''` when absent | takes an optional `NavTargetLabelResolver`; the label is `navEntryLabelText(node, locale, targetLabel)`, so an absent label inherits. `''` only for a present label that resolves to nothing (an empty map) |
| Studio canvas caption, breadcrumb (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) | the target's internal name | the inherited text; `type · name` stays on both tooltips |
| Studio copilot "discussing" chip | `object · b2r4_customer` (the `type · name` fallback) | the inherited text; `type · name` stays on the chip's tooltip (objectui#7254's reachable half) |
| `StudioNavItemInspector` Label field | value = authored text; placeholder = a fixed "e.g. Positions" hint; emptying wrote `label: ''` | value = authored text; placeholder = `inheritedNavEntryText`; emptying applies `clearedLabel` and REMOVES the key (a map loses only the designer locale's entry) |
| `StudioNavItemInspector` object bind | removed a label equal to `''` or the "New item" sentinel | leaves the label as it is, the shape `AppNavInspector`'s picker has |
| `AppNavCanvas` `addItem` | births `{ id, type: 'object', label: 'New item' }` (localized) | births `{ id, type: 'object' }`; the card shows its `id` until a target is bound, then that target's label |

- **Resolver on all three ways a leaf opens.** `NavTree` passes `useNavTargetLabel` to `resolveSurface`, so a click opens a Surface named exactly as the row is. The load effect's first-leaf pick and the `?surface=` restore read the resolver through a ref after the load's awaits: the latest resolver, and never a dependency of that effect, whose re-run rehydrates the nav edit buffer (AGENTS.md Commandment 10: nothing rests on the hook's memoised identity).
- **Sentinel gone.** Nothing births "New item" any more, so `StudioNavItemInspector`'s `isPlaceholder` matching is removed. A stored legacy "New item" is a present label and renders verbatim (pinned).
- **Dead strings.** `engine.appNav.newItem` lost its last reader with the birth, and `engine.studio.nav.labelPlaceholder` with the placeholder. Both are removed from the en and zh designer tables. No gate list names either key (`git grep` over `scripts/`: zero hits), so there was no list entry to remove.

## Premises re-measured at `origin/main` `cb2f6fb5b`

- `resolveSurface` resolved the label once, in the designer locale, `''` when absent: confirmed. `StudioNavItemInspector`'s `isPlaceholder` and `addItem`'s `t('engine.appNav.newItem', locale)`: confirmed.
- PR objectui#11225 already stopped the bind adopting the object's label: confirmed, not duplicated. What remained was the sentinel and `''` drop, now removed.
- **Falsified:** "the pickers' ... `AppNavInspector`'s" sentinel handling. `AppNavInspector.tsx` on `origin/main` has no "New item" or `engine.appNav.newItem` read at all (its picker already kept whatever label the entry had). Nothing to remove there.
- PR objectui#11230's sent-snapshot claim covers a label-less birth: confirmed by the objectui#11204 case "an edit undone while the save is in flight leaves the buffer as it landed" and the objectui#11189 in-flight cases, all green with label-less entries.

## Pins

New:
- `StudioDesignSurface.surfaceLabelInherits-11196.test.tsx` (real `InterfacesPillar`, real `MetadataCtx`): the first-leaf pick, the `?surface=` restore and a rail click each caption and breadcrumb a label-less leaf with its dashboard's label, identity on the tooltip; CONTROL: an authored label spelled unlike its dashboard's renders verbatim.
- `StudioDesignSurface.navItemInspectorLabel-11196.test.tsx`: value / placeholder for a label-less bound entry, an unbound birth entry (placeholder = its `id`) and an authored label (CONTROL); emptying removes the key (never `''`) and parses; a map loses only its en-US entry; typing writes a label (CONTROL); bind keeps label-less label-less and a legacy "New item" verbatim.
- `AppNavCanvas.labelLessBirth-11196.test.tsx`: the appended entry is exactly `{ id: 'nav_item_2', type: 'object' }` with no `label` key in memory or on the wire; the selection is titled by its `id`; the card shows the `id` unbound and the object's label bound; CONTROL: a stored "New item" renders verbatim.
- `navSurface.test.ts`: six resolver cases, including the empty-map control (present-but-empty is not absent) and `findSurfaceInTree` handing the resolver to the leaf it finds.

Re-judged by this slice, intent kept:
- objectui#8219 chip pin (`StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel.test.tsx`): the unlabelled leaf's chip reads the inherited text `客户` with `object · b2r4_customer` on its tooltip. Per review `5914452475`, the pin clicks the rail row by name, so its `useMetadata` mock now carries `objects` (a `vi.hoisted` module-level value, stable identity) and the row is clicked as `客户 对象`.
- objectui#11189 autosave pins, and the siblings objectui#11204 (nav case) and objectui#11167: the rail counter counts `nav_item_N` ids, and a save's entries read `{ id: 'nav_item_3' }` for an entry saved with no `label` key. Every behavioural assertion (an Add during an in-flight save lands in the next save; "Done" flushes; a failed send keeps the edit; an undone edit leaves the buffer clean) is unchanged.
- objectui#11201 bind pin: its "New item placeholder bound ... has no label" case pinned exactly the removed branch, so it is replaced by the label-less birth bound to each object (no `label`, parses) plus a legacy "New item" kept verbatim. `navSurface.test.ts`'s "an item with no label carries an empty label, as before" now reads the inherited `pageName`. `StudioDesignSurface.navItemInspector.test.tsx`'s bind fixture is the label-less birth.

## Ablations (each committed first; mutation and restore proven on disk by `ablation-replace.mjs`, then `git diff HEAD` empty; no dist leg, the pins import `src`)

- A, `resolveSurface` ignores its resolver: 6 of 42 red, exactly the chip case, the three surface cases and two resolver cases; controls green.
- B, `addItem` births "New item" again: 7 of 11 red, the two birth cases and 5 of 6 objectui#11189 cases (the clean-buffer control green).
- C, emptying writes through `renamedLabel`: 2 of 8 red (the two emptying cases).
- D, the placeholder removed: 3 of 8 red (the three placeholder cases).

## Tests and gates at `436a74e80`

Every run below is at `436a74e80` (the only commit), from the worktree root, `pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=verbose` with root-relative paths; pass counts read from vitest's own summary lines.

- Build closure: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, 28 of 28 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

Declared narrowing: this one run went outside the shared verify lock with one worker, after about 20 minutes queued behind a long holder.
- Directory sweeps, in chunks under the lock: `studio-design/` 81 of 81 files (131 + 336 tests); `metadata-admin/previews/` and `metadata-admin/inspectors/` 208 of 208 files (709 + 848 + 1217 tests, 1 pre-existing skip in `flow-node-config.spec-reconciliation.test.ts`). 0 failed anywhere.

- Gates, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; neither removed key appears, and no remaining `engine.appNav` / `engine.studio.nav` key is listed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the four pending changesets naming `i18n.ts` / `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` were read and still hold: no new module import, no key they name removed), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 15 paths).
- NOT MEASURED: CI (the full farm, `pnpm lint`, e2e) and a browser run.

## Acceptance notes

- The Surface's label is resolved when the leaf opens and is not refreshed afterwards, as before for the locale and for a rename in the inspector. A label-less leaf opened before its target's metadata loads keeps the machine name until it is opened again; the load reads the latest resolver after its awaits, which narrows but does not close that window.
- A legacy `label: ''` (written by the old inspector's emptying) is no longer dropped on bind; it stays as authored, like any present label. `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's `NavigationItemSchema` and `AppSchema` both accept `label: ''` (measured locally with `safeParse`), so slice 1's `navItemLabel.ts` sentence that "the save door refuses it" does not hold for the spec parse; the server's save door was not measured.
- carrier: 承接者:无. plugin-designer's `NavigationDesigner` births object / dashboard / page entries with a `New` + type label, the same producer shape `addItem` had. It is outside this claim, and no host in this repo renders `navigation-designer` with app metadata (slice 1's reading).
